Do not redraw the upper treads, do not turn it into a front view, and do not make an isometric view.

Use the primary guide ONLY for camera/footprint. Use the secondary native target images ONLY for wood colors, outline style, rail construction and row identity. No stone pixels or unrelated style. Transparent background, crisp pixel-art, centered complete isolated object per row, no clipping, no text or gridlines.
